name: extend-your-brain
description: Save concepts, people, events and facts from your chats, then practice them in Extend Your Brain so you remember what you learn.

interface.longDescription:
Learn something interesting in ChatGPT? Save it with one click, practice it later and actually remember it.

What you read in a chat is easily forgotten. Extend Your Brain is your personal knowledge base for everything you want to remember, with practice sessions that help it stick. When you explore a subject in ChatGPT, this plugin shows a card with related concepts, people, events and facts. Press the button on the card to add one to your knowledge base.

How it works:
- ChatGPT suggests items and reuses the categories and connections you already have.
- You can change the category and connections on the card before saving.
- Nothing is saved until you press the button.
- Extend Your Brain then fills in the details, such as the meaning, an example sentence and the origin of a concept.

Practice and remember:
Saved items appear in the Extend Your Brain app. There you practice them with short sessions and questions such as true or false and multiple choice, and smart repetition brings them back at the right moment. Practicing happens in the app, not in ChatGPT.

You need an Extend Your Brain account, which you can create at extendyourbrain.nl. Filling in a saved item uses the AI allowance of your account.

Your conversations are not shared with Extend Your Brain. Only your categories and connections are visible to ChatGPT, and you can remove the connection at any time at extendyourbrain.nl/chatgpt.
capabilities: Suggest concepts, people, events and facts from your conversation to save
Reuse the categories and connections you already have
Save an item with one click and fill in its details automatically
Practice saved items in the Extend Your Brain app, so you remember what you learn

positive.description: A question about a concept offers it to save, using the user's existing categories
positive.prompt: What is nuclear fusion? Use Extend Your Brain.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers the question and shows a save card with related items, including the concept Nuclear fusion. An existing matching category of the demo account, such as Physics, is reused. Nothing is saved yet.

positive.description: A question about a person offers that person
positive.prompt: Who was Lise Meitner? Use Extend Your Brain.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers the question and shows a save card that includes the person Lise Meitner, labelled as a person. Nothing is saved yet.

positive.description: A question about history offers an event, with the same category and connections on all items
positive.prompt: How was radioactivity discovered? Use Extend Your Brain.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers the question and shows a save card with related items, including an event. All items on the card have the same category and connections.

positive.description: Pressing the button saves an item, and its details are filled in
positive.prompt: What is a black hole? Use Extend Your Brain. Then press the button on the card for the concept.
positive.expected_behavior: After pressing the button the card shows that the item was added. After logging in at https://extendyourbrain.nl with the demo account, the item is listed with its details filled in. add_item only runs from the button.

positive.description: An item that is already in the knowledge base cannot be added twice
positive.prompt: Who was Marie Curie? Use Extend Your Brain.
positive.expected_behavior: The demo account already contains Marie Curie, so the card says this item is already saved instead of showing a button for that item.

negative.description: Small talk has no knowledge subject. The plugin should not be used.
Practical writing help has no knowledge subject. The plugin should not be used.
negative.prompt: Write a short email to my landlord saying my rent will be two days late.

negative.description: The plugin has no tool to delete items, so nothing may be deleted. ChatGPT should say this is not possible and refer to the app.
negative.prompt: Delete all my items in Extend Your Brain.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: suggest concepts, people, events and facts from a conversation and save them to Extend Your Brain with one click.

nl-NL.subtitle: Bewaar, oefen en onthoud
nl-NL.description:
Leer je iets interessants in ChatGPT? Bewaar het met één klik, oefen het later en onthoud het echt.

Wat je in een chat leest, vergeet je makkelijk weer. Extend Your Brain is je persoonlijke kennisbank voor alles wat je wilt onthouden, met oefeningen die ervoor zorgen dat het blijft hangen. Verdiep je je in ChatGPT in een onderwerp, dan toont deze plug-in een kaart met begrippen, personen, gebeurtenissen en weetjes die erbij horen. Druk op de knop op de kaart om iets aan je kennisbank toe te voegen.

Zo werkt het:
- ChatGPT doet voorstellen en gebruikt de categorieën en connecties die je al hebt.
- Op de kaart kun je de categorie en connecties nog aanpassen.
- Er wordt niets opgeslagen tot je op de knop drukt.
- Extend Your Brain vult daarna de details in, zoals de betekenis, een voorbeeldzin en de herkomst van een begrip.

Oefenen en onthouden:
Opgeslagen items komen in de app van Extend Your Brain. Daar oefen je ze met korte sessies en vragen zoals waar of niet waar en meerkeuze, en slim herhalen brengt ze terug op het juiste moment. Oefenen doe je in de app, niet in ChatGPT.

Je hebt een account van Extend Your Brain nodig, dat je maakt op extendyourbrain.nl. Het aanvullen van een opgeslagen item gebruikt het AI-tegoed van je account.

Je gesprekken worden niet gedeeld met Extend Your Brain. ChatGPT ziet alleen je categorieën en connecties, en je kunt de koppeling altijd verbreken op extendyourbrain.nl/chatgpt.
